subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers adopt or close the dirty open fork PR before this issue is queued for a fresh narrow Control UI fix?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but an open fork PR still references this issue with closing syntax and is not merge-ready, so automation should not create a duplicate fix until maintainers choose that path.

options.title: Close the fork path and queue a fresh fix
options.body: Close or supersede the dirty fork PR, then let a new narrow Control UI fix address this issue against current main.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor rebase the fork branch and repair it against the current Debug page structure before review.

recommendation.title: Close the fork path and queue a fresh fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the dirty fork PR, then let a new narrow Control UI fix address this issue against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history on the original Debug dashboard wiring and recent Control UI ownership signals.
